name: Stacia Noorda
occupation: Hot Springs County treasurer-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Stacia Noorda is the Hot Springs County treasurer-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Julie Mortimore, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election results list her as the winner of the treasurer race.
